categories.label: Low short-read mappability
categories.definition: Union of GEM non-unique contexts under the documented 100 bp and 250 bp alignment settings; the source identifies contexts where short-read mapping can be challenging.

categories.label: Segmental duplications
categories.definition: UCSC genomicSuperDups-derived regions. Source segments within 100 bp were merged; these are generally repeated regions longer than 1 kb with greater than 90% similarity.

categories.label: Long tandem repeats (≥101 bp)
categories.definition: Union repeat annotation filtered by underlying repeat length. Five base pairs of slop are added and are not part of the named length threshold; the separately defined homopolymer set is excluded.

categories.label: Satellites
categories.definition: RepeatMasker Satellite class intervals, with overlaps merged and then five base pairs of slop added.

categories.label: Reference gaps ±15 kb
categories.definition: Regions within 15 kb of a GRCh38 reference gap. This is reference sequence context, not missing sample data.

categories.label: Correct copy of falsely duplicated sequence
categories.definition: GIAB's correct-copy side of falsely duplicated GRCh38 regions. This is a reference representation stratum, not a sample-level error.

categories.label: VDJ / IGL named stratum
categories.definition: RefSeq genes matching IGH, IGK, IGL, TRA, TRB, or TRG; these loci are highly polymorphic and usually rearranged. The chromosome 22 source interval is IGL.
